messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High severity - multiple GPU driver resets observed on gw-node-22 (region-us-west). Symptoms: pod restarts, OOMKilled, kubelet marking NotReady. Auto-page to oncall.
samira (oncall): Acked. I'm looking now. Any customer-facing incidents yet? :eyes:
olivia (support): We have 2 active customer reports about inference timeouts in us-west. Tickets #CS-3145 and #CS-3146.
samira (oncall): Ok. Pulling logs from gw-node-22.
kevin (eng-runtime): heads-up: recent runtime push included a driver package update to 535. Try to correlate.
samira (oncall): dmesg excerpt:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 12345.679002] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID=24812, GPU=0
[ 12345.679103] kernel: NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed! (0x23:0xffffffff)
[ 12346.000000] kubelet: Node gw-node-22 marked NotReady - container runtime not responding
```
samira (oncall): Pod describe shows repeated restarts and OOMKilled for inference-worker-abc:
```
State:          Running
Last State:     Terminated
  Reason:       OOMKilled
  Exit Code:    137
Restart Count:  12
```
natalie (eng-sre): Looks like GPU driver resets causing processes to leak memory / stuck. First mitigation: cordon + drain non-critical nodes to reduce scheduler pressure. Samira, can you cordon gw-node-22 and evict best-effort pods?
samira (oncall): Running:
```
kubectl cordon gw-node-22
kubectl drain gw-node-22 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```
samira (oncall): Drain started. Evicting inference-worker best-effort pods, leaving customer-critical pods pinned for now.
david (infra-lead): I want a graceful approach. If driver module is in bad state, we should avoid rebooting immediately on prod. Plan: (1) isolate node, (2) try nvidia-driver restart via daemonset that restarts kubelet NV hook, (3) if not recovered within 10m, schedule reboot off-peak. Agreed?
kevin (eng-runtime): Agreed. Command to restart driver glue pod:
```
kubectl rollout restart ds/nvidia-driver -n kube-system
```
kevin (eng-runtime): Also check kernel logs for OOM killer patterns and pci bus errors.
samira (oncall): Performed driver ds restart. Watching metrics. Node GPU memory usage reports look jittery and then drop when processes crash.
incident-bot: Update: gw-node-22 still NotReady after 6m; restart attempt returned status CrashLoopBackOff for nvidia-driver pod.
natalie (eng-sre): CrashLoopBackOff suggests kernel-level fault. Please capture a full dmesg + journalctl and tarball core-dumps. Use runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-driver-failure
samira (oncall): Uploading logs to /tmp/inc-1866004321.tar (link: https://files.redwood/inc-1866004321)
olivia (support): Messaging affected customers: brief note prepared: "We're investigating GPU instability in us-west causing inference timeouts. Engineering is mitigating. We'll provide updates every 15m." Send now? :mailbox_with_mail:
samira (oncall): Sent to customers in CS-3145/3146. Included workaround: retry with smaller batch size and lower max_tokens.
kevin (eng-runtime): Quick root cause hypothesis: recent driver 535 regression on certain Ampere machines causing Xid 79 under sustained KV cache pressure. Will reproduce on staging GPUs.
david (infra-lead): Escalating to infra pager @david (infra-lead) for decision on reboot window. If we can't recover in 20m, schedule rolling reboots across the node pool to avoid broad outage.
samira (oncall): Handoff note for next oncall (if I go offline): gw-node-22 isolated, driver ds restarted once (CrashLoopBackOff), logs uploaded, customers notified, short term: reduce traffic by shifting a small % to us-east via smart routing. Next steps: reboot node if DR doesn't clear.
pagebot: oncall-handoff created for 2023-06-14 23:30 UTC, assigned to david (infra-lead).
david (infra-lead): I'll take over. Starting coordinated reboot in 12m if no improvement. Natalie, Kevin - plan a pre- and post-checklist: healthz, nvme, dmesg, pod eviction success metrics.
natalie (eng-sre): I'll prepare the checklist and watch the cluster autoscaler. Also enabling stricter OOM eviction thresholds temporarily.
kevin (eng-runtime): Reproducer job queued on staging (job/gpu-xid-repro). I will post updates there. If reproduces, we'll roll back driver on prod image.
olivia (support): Customers acknowledged. One requested an ETA; gave ~30-45m and said we'll update.
samira (oncall): Adding incident summary to channel once stable. Tagging stakeholders: @product, @sales. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident recorded: INC-1866004321. Severity: P1. Timeline notes being collected.
samira (oncall): Leaving detailed notes in the runbook; handing to David to continue operational actions. :wave:
